headline: EHR Implementation Consultant | Workflow Consultation and Configuration | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, a US EHR company, owning end-to-end implementations for two strategic clients as part of a formal implementation team. I run discovery, document current workflows and pain points, then design and configure practice-specific workflows in the EHR. I have trained 200+ end users, from providers to medical assistants, and presented to clients and at Greenway's provider conference. Hospital practice in emergency medicine and ICU means I know how documentation, registration and scheduling actually run on the floor.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end EHR implementations for two strategic clients, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, setup and adoption.
Ran discovery with each practice to document pain points, business processes and goals, then designed and configured practice-specific workflows and widgets.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on the new workflows.
Turned recurring client pain points into feature requests and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: business discovery, requirements gathering, current- and future-state workflow mapping, system configuration, go-live and setup support, implementation project team
role-based end-user training, clinical staff training, SOP writing, user adoption, stakeholder communication
defect triage, patient safety review, stage-gate release, clinical documentation workflows, emergency, ICU and inpatient care
thesis_html: EHR workflows that match the floor, configured by someone who's worked it.
why_fit: Documented each practice's workflows and pain points, then configured the EHR to fit.
Hands-on configuration and setup support for two strategic clients.
I know what clinicians need from documentation and scheduling.
